reason: I use AI all day at work, but I don't let it touch my money, and a cartoon pet running my portfolio is the opposite of what I want there. My robo-adviser is boring and that's why I trust it. I'm not joining a waitlist for a paid plan when there's no broker named yet and no price.
objection: An AI agent that can move my money and pay for things on its own, from a startup with no licensed broker in place yet, dressed up as a Tamagotchi. Limits and a kill switch sound nice, but I'd still be the one cleaning up if it does something dumb.
would_change_my_mind: A named, established licensed broker holding the money with SIPC coverage, and a mode where the agent only suggests and I approve every move, with a year of track record I can check.
